outcome: postoperative pain scores at rest, with coughing, and upon standing at 8, 16, and 24 hours post-cesarean section
finding: This study demonstrates that TAP block significantly reduces postoperative pain scores compared to standard care in women undergoing cesarean section in a low-income, resource-limited setting.
mod_finding: This study demonstrates that TAP block significantly reduces postoperative pain scores compared to standard care in women undergoing cesarean section in a low-income, resource-limited setting.
